Entries.ElliottHouse.2: Elliott's desk. It's littered with notes and crumpled balls of paper, one of which has a couple lines scribbled on it that reads:#The moment I laid eyes on them, it was like I was hearing music from heaven.^From that moment on, I knew only two paths were left before me.^Should it all end it failure, I shall be destined to suffer the eternal flames of hell.
Entries.ElliottHouse.3: There's a knife in the cupboard... I have no idea what it's doing here...

Entries.ElliottHouse.2: Elliott's desk. It's littered with notes and crumpled balls of paper, one of which has a couple lines scribbled on it that reads:#Even at this very moment, my heart is consumed by feelings of unease.^I swear to you, I wouldn't hesitate to grovel on my knees and beg for the favor of each and every god if it meant you'd never leave me.^After all, unless we're all dead, how else can anything last forever?

Elliott's desk. It's littered with notes and crumpled balls of paper, one of which has a couple lines scribbled on it that reads:#I understand I must be content with what I have at this moment. I must restrain my impulses.^And yet, with every second I spend with you, my greedy heart only grows more and more difficult to satisfy.^What must I do to make you look solely at me? What must I do to ensure you'll never leave me?^If it means making a deal with the devil, then a deal I shall make. Even if the price were to sell my soul, I'd have no regrets.^But even still, my heart is overwhelmed by fear. I don't want to lay waste to all of our progress. I don't want you to view me with nothing but disgust and anger.^@, I can only assure you of this: I will try. I will try to control myself, I promise.

Elliott's desk. It's littered with notes and crumpled balls of paper, one of which has a couple lines scribbled on it that reads:#I have to do this, it's the only way out.^Fear or hate, at least I won't be forgotten by you.
Entries.ElliottHouse.4: It looks like Elliott once intended to plant something here, but it looks very neglected. There's not much life left in it.
Entries.ElliottHouse.6: It looks like Elliott once intended to plant something here, but it's been long since neglected. There's not much left of it now.
